_help: Registry of published analyses shown on /insights.html (and up to three featured items on the homepage).
Only add pieces that are already published, with their real URL. Then run: python tools/build_site.py
Fields: title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), topic (one of categories), summary (one or two sentences),
url (https link to the original LinkedIn post or article), source (e.g. LinkedIn), image (optional: /assets/insights/file.webp or empty), image_alt (optional), featured (true/false).
